assumptions.statement: Exact statutory controls, road redlines, ownership, investment, approval paths and phasing commitments are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: All precision-sensitive moves remain conceptual suggestions; no parcel action or government commitment is asserted.
assumptions.closure: Replace with official controls and professional/rights-holder confirmation, then rerun geometry, metrics and review.

assumptions.statement: The organizer repository currently provides only a rough fitted 11.4 km² boundary and three key-area placeholder rectangles.
assumptions.impact: Area checks are consistency calculations, not statutory accuracy; all nine layers and figures require full recomputation.
assumptions.closure: Obtain official polygons and rebuild topology/metrics as one change set.

assumptions.statement: The provisional south key-area rectangle is materially displaced from the contextual Dazhongsi station anchor identified in open contextual data.
assumptions.impact: South-area work is a typological context window, never a parcel or station plan.
assumptions.closure: Use official key-area geometry and current surveyed station exits before precise design.

assumptions.statement: Building use, condition, structure, fire safety, heritage status, title, occupancy, adaptability and relocation effects are unknown.
assumptions.impact: No building is labelled vacant, low-efficiency, unsafe, reusable, openable or demolishable; geometry shows concept prototypes only.
assumptions.closure: Professional building and user/rights survey with documented consent.

assumptions.statement: Campus entry, station exits, crossings, step-free continuity and public opening hours can change and are incompletely mapped.
assumptions.impact: Permanent public routes stay outside campuses; exact entrances and catchments are not claimed.
assumptions.closure: Current field access audit and operator/institution confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Electricity, heat, water, drainage, communications, compute, underground and emergency capacities are unknown.
assumptions.impact: No megaproject or quantitative capacity claim; use existing eligible services first and add only after proof.
assumptions.closure: Utility records, engineering surveys, operator approval and life-cycle/exit plan.

assumptions.statement: Delivery, maintenance, waste, event, worker, business and residential conflicts are not established at site level.
assumptions.impact: Service routes and operating windows remain an audit layer, not an asserted hidden network.
assumptions.closure: Timed field observation and user/operator co-design.

assumptions.statement: No named organization, carrier, model, dataset, operator or partnership is committed to the three bounded AI task packets.
assumptions.impact: AI spaces are reversible typologies with NO-BUILD outcomes, not promised facilities or endorsements.
assumptions.closure: Verified task owner, authorization, minimum resource, qualified human review, carrier and exit agreement.
